sanitization.images: omitted; text/DOM/network evidence was sufficient and avoids incidental UI state

sourceFindings.preconditions: seeded QA server; S3 isolated browser; QA Local Chat selected; only loopback mock configured
steps: Open Basic Chat and wait for connected model groups
Select the seeded QA Chat Ready qa-chat model
Enter QA browser chat and press Enter
Observe the actual UI request path and assistant state
Reproduce the same request path with seeded qa-openai/qa-chat
sourceFindings.expected: The UI posts to an implemented local chat endpoint, streams QA mock reply, and the request terminates at 127.0.0.1:22129.
sourceFindings.actual: The UI posts to /api/dashboard/chat/completions, which is not implemented and returns 404 text/html. The conversation renders Error: Failed to fetch and the mock is never reached. The UI-selected request model is also the internal id openai-compatible-chat-qa-local/qa-chat rather than the seeded qa-openai/qa-chat alias.
sourceFindings.console: none; the failure is rendered in the transcript

sourceFindings.preconditions: seeded QA server; desktop viewport; pointer-open Create Combo
steps: Open Create Combo
Inspect dialog semantics and active element
Press Tab twice
sourceFindings.expected: The modal exposes dialog semantics, moves focus inside, traps Tab/Shift+Tab, and returns focus on close.
sourceFindings.actual: No role=dialog or aria-modal is exposed. Focus remains on the background Create Combo button; Tab moves to background judge and strategy controls instead of modal controls.

sourceFindings.control: Model row value / Click to edit
sourceFindings.preconditions: Create or edit a combo containing a compatible-provider model
steps: Open Create/Edit Combo
Add a compatible-provider model
Tab through the model row
Try to edit the model ID without a pointer
sourceFindings.expected: The visually clickable model value is focusable and Enter/Space opens its inline editor.
sourceFindings.actual: The model value is a DIV with an onClick handler, no role, and no tabindex. Keyboard focus skips it, so exact compatible model IDs cannot be edited keyboard-only.

sourceFindings.preconditions: seeded local model selected; X-QA-Synthetic-State pending stream; no external traffic
steps: Send QA stop chat
While the request is pending, activate Stop
Inspect the transcript
sourceFindings.expected: The provisional assistant turn is removed or visibly marked cancelled/stopped.
sourceFindings.actual: Stop aborts the request and removes the Stop button, but leaves a blank assistant turn with no cancelled/stopped status.
sourceFindings.network: synthetic pending POST /api/dashboard/chat/completions aborted locally; no upstream request

sourceFindings.preconditions: a conversation with messages exists in History
steps: Open Basic Chat
Complete or populate one conversation
Inspect header, History, and composer actions
Try to start a new conversation with the same model while preserving the existing chat
sourceFindings.expected: A named New conversation action starts a fresh same-model session and keeps the current session in History.
sourceFindings.actual: No New conversation action exists. Clear deletes the active session; only switching provider/model conditionally creates a new session.

sourceFindings.preconditions: Basic Chat loaded with and without an active model
steps: Inspect the accessibility tree for composer actions
Focus Attach, Send, and Stop
sourceFindings.expected: Each icon-only action has a human-readable accessible name such as Attach image, Send message, and Stop generating.
sourceFindings.actual: Accessible names are the Material Symbols glyph strings attach_file, arrow_upward, and stop; no aria-label or visually hidden name is provided.

basic-chat-404.json.uiObserved: User message rendered, assistant remained streaming, then displayed Error: Failed to fetch after the request failed.

basic-chat-controls.json.observedBehavior: Selecting another model after messages creates a new session, but there is no way to start a new same-model conversation while preserving the current chat in History. Clear deletes the active chat.
basic-chat-controls.json.expected: A named New conversation action, transcript/message copy action, and human-readable accessible names for icon-only composer controls.

steps: Select seeded local qa-chat
Send QA stop chat
Activate Stop while request is pending
basic-chat-stop.json.expected: Cancellation removes the provisional assistant turn or marks it visibly stopped/cancelled.
basic-chat-stop.json.actual: The provisional assistant turn remains blank with no cancelled/stopped status.

combo-modal-a11y.json.expected: Opening moves focus into a dialog; Tab remains within it; dialog exposes role=dialog and aria-modal=true.
combo-modal-a11y.json.actual: Focus remains on the background opener, then Tabs through background combo-card controls; no dialog semantics are exposed.

combo-model-inline-edit.json.control: Model row value / Click to edit
combo-model-inline-edit.json.keyboardProbe: The model text itself is absent from the sequential focus order; adjacent drag, Move up, Move down, and Remove buttons are focusable.
combo-model-inline-edit.json.expected: The visually actionable model value is a button or otherwise focusable and supports Enter/Space.
combo-model-inline-edit.json.actual: Only pointer click enters model-ID editing. This blocks keyboard-only entry of exact compatible model IDs after selecting a model-id placeholder.
